what: Effective degrees of freedom per smooth — edf
title: Effective degrees of freedom per smooth — edf
text: TMB hand way mgcv's PIRLS , derived explicitly. fitted smoothing parameters penalized Hessian joint negative log-likelihood coefficients $$H = H_{data} + S, \quad S = diag(0 \text{ fixed}, 1/\sigma_k^2 \text{ block } k),$$ penalty exactly diagonal mgcv::smooth2random() basis. Wood's effective degrees freedom, \(tr((X'WX + S)^{-1} X'WX)\), therefore generalise $$F = H^{-1} H_{data} = - H^{-1} S, \quad       edf_j = 1 - s_j [H^{-1}]_{jj},$$ diagonal \(H^{-1}\) needed: null-space coefficients contribute exactly 1 penalized ones 0 1.

title: Randomised quantile (pseudo) residuals — residuals.gamRTMB
text: response atoms, \(F\) step function \(u\) uniform, residual randomised within step (Dunn & Smyth 1996): $$u_i = F(y_i^-) + v_i (F(y_i) - F(y_i^-)), \quad v_i \sim U(0,1).$$ left limit \(F(y^-)\) comes family's declared support, since obtained reliably way: continuous \(F(y^-) = F(y)\) randomisation happens. lattice \(F(y^-) = F(y-1)\), evaluated integer arguments , taken 0 \(y = 0\) rather evaluating CDF support. mixed \(F(y^-) = F(y) - p(y)\) atom, density returns atom's mass, \(F(y)\) elsewhere. Nudging argument instead (\(F(y-\delta)\)) safe: CDF implementations disagree whether floor non-integer argument, reject one outright.
